gridEmpty: Nothing yet: add an image or a video from your media library.
inCellHelp: With no set format, the image keeps its own. With a format: “Whole image” shows it in full, “Fill the cell” crops it.
boxFull: Full width: the alignment only shows if you reduce the width.
boxPhone: On phones, the block takes the full width.
railHint: A video is set on its image, on the page: Loop or Player.
railEmpty: Nothing yet: add images or videos from your media library (or drag them in from the Media tab).
convertHelp: The images, their order, captions, frames and backgrounds are kept. Anything that does not exist in the other form (layout, crop…) is set aside and comes back if you switch back here.
belongs: This block belongs to the project: it appears wherever the project is shown.
projectStrip: This strip shows the project's images: add, move and caption them directly on the page.
strokeHelp: Lay a colour over the line of these images' scroll bar, with the opacity of your choice: it blends with the original drawing. With no setting, it uses the site's colour, otherwise the theme's.
